title: Snap Shape to Object (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Snap Shape to Object applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Snap Shape to Object (BtnSnapShape) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Snap placement and nearest-direction decision are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The nearest side is decided from the two shape centers with the horizontal axis winning ties (a non-negative horizontal delta resolves Right); placement sits flush to the target on the requested side and centers on the perpendicular axis (a moving shape taller than the target centers with a negative offset); an unknown direction anchors at the target's top-left.

scenarios.title: Snap Shape aligns the moving shape edge-to-edge with the target in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Snap Shape on two shapes with a 240 pt horizontal and 170 pt vertical gap moves the first (moving) shape until it is edge-aligned with the second (target) shape on at least one axis pair (minimum edge distance within 0.5 pt), leaves the target shape exactly at its original position (within 0.5 pt), reports execution, keeps the shape count unchanged, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
